1. When it happens and what changes

From the server save on the **12th** to the server save on the **15th** of each month, the full moon rises over **Grimvale**. The island's {creature:Bandit|Bandits} turn into {wiki:Were-Creatures|were-creatures} (all kinds of {wiki:Lycanthropes|lycanthropes}). Take the chance to do the {wiki:Grimvale Quest} and free the island from the curse.
During the full moon the island is full of aggressive lycanthropes. Do not go with a low level.

Travel to **Edron** (to the port captain of your city: {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}) and walk to **Stonehome**, northeast of the city. North of Stonehome is {npc:Cornell}'s ferry: say {key:hi}, {key:passage} and confirm with {key:yes} (100 gp). You disembark at the **south** dock of Grimvale, near the village.

**Every time** before you face Feroxa you have to hand in 3 {item:Purple Nightshade Blossoms} to {npc:Maeryn} and kill 50 were-creatures, as explained in the *The Curse of the Full Moon* part of the {wiki:Grimvale Quest}.

Enter the Grimvale dungeon by dropping through the {item:Pitfall} in the **northeast** of the island and go down to the deepest floor (the ruins floor). {creature:Feroxa}'s antechamber is behind a **teleport** on that floor.
Pitfall: way down to the Grimvale dungeon
On the 13th these server messages appear. Enter Feroxa's antechamber before the last phase: everyone who is there is teleported and the fight begins.
All players in Feroxa's antechamber are teleported and the fight begins.
{creature:Feroxa} is a boss: go with a team and well prepared.

After the fight, go back the same way to the surface, climbing up with the {item:Rope} through the floors you went down. At the **south** dock of the island say {key:hi}, {key:sail} and {key:yes} to {npc:Cornell} (100 gp): he takes you back to **Edron**, to the dock north of Stonehome.
